name: HeyReach
description: HeyReach lets agents read LinkedIn outreach campaigns, lead lists, and conversations in the signed-in HeyReach workspace. Each user signs in to their own HeyReach account through the browser.

prompts.text: How are my active campaigns doing on acceptance and reply rates?
List the leads who replied this week and what they said.
Draft a short LinkedIn follow-up for a lead who accepted but did not reply.

apps.name: HeyReach
apps.description: Campaign, lead list, and conversation access, over HeyReach's MCP server with browser sign-in.
